name: qryptive-pqc
description: Find quantum-vulnerable cryptography in your repo (Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript). Runs fully locally in a sandboxed container; your source code never leaves your machine. A free one-time email sign-in is required, and each run checks in without sending code, file names or results. Optional dashboard sync. Also includes an opt-in agent edit guard you can install per repository to check the cryptography a coding agent writes, also fully locally.
